description: Every Better Stack Uptime feature, plus an offline SQLite mirror and cross-resource fleet analytics — what's down and who's paged, coverage gaps, MTTA/MTTR, flapping, on-call gaps, and status-page drift — that the API alone can't answer.

novel_features.name: Fleet health board
novel_features.description: One-screen health of the whole Better Stack account: monitors up/down/paused, heartbeats, open incidents, and who's on call now.

novel_features.name: Alerting coverage gaps
novel_features.description: Find monitors with no escalation policy or no alert channel — the ones that will go down silently and page no one.

novel_features.name: Incident MTTA / MTTR
novel_features.description: Mean time to acknowledge and resolve, computed across incidents over a window and broken down by monitor.

novel_features.name: Flapping / noisy monitors
novel_features.description: Rank monitors by how many incidents they generated in a window to surface the noisy, flapping, or misconfigured ones.

novel_features.name: On-call coverage gaps
novel_features.description: Detect on-call calendars with nobody currently on call.

novel_features.name: Heartbeat risk audit
novel_features.description: Rank heartbeats by risk: tight period+grace windows, paused-but-expected, and non-up status.

novel_features.name: What's-down triage board
novel_features.description: Focused triage list of monitors currently down or degraded, joined to their open incidents and whether anyone is actually paged for each.

novel_features.name: Unacked-incident triage
novel_features.description: Open incidents ranked by age and acknowledgement state — never-acknowledged first — joined to the affected monitor.

novel_features.name: Status-page drift audit
novel_features.description: Flags status pages showing operational while a backing monitor has an open incident, and status-page resources pointing at missing or paused monitors.

novel_features.name: Group rollup health
novel_features.description: Per-group health rollup: monitor and heartbeat up/down counts plus open incidents for every monitor group and heartbeat group.
